description: A groundbreaking celebration of music and technology featuring cellist Jeffrey Zeigler and London-based Gandini Juggling.

name: “Division of Time” (LATE SHOW)
description: A second world premiere performance exploring humanity's relationship to numbers through cello, piano, and juggling.

name: Meaghan Robichaud Is The Greatest Show on Earth
description: An anti-acrobatic solo circus performance featuring "the world's worst male clown" and fearless feats of flapdoodle.
short_name: Meaghan Robichaud Is The Greatest Show on Earth

name: Neal Medlyn: Made in Heaven
description: A performance and visual art piece featuring live music, dance, painting, and video inspired by the Jeff Koons and Cicciolina art disaster.

name: Concert | Oliver Neubauer, violin & Michael Yeung, percussion
description: A mid-day performance featuring virtuoso violin and percussion work by emerging artists in the museum's intimate hall.
short_name: Concert | Oliver Neubauer, violin & Michael Yeung, percussion

name: The Attention Wars (AKA) How Reality Crosses the Mind
description: A poetic and hilarious journey of a NYC public school teacher searching for a remedy for human disconnection.
short_name: The Attention Wars How Reality Crosses the Mind

name: Opening Reception: Light and Whispers
description: A photopoetic exhibition featuring black-and-white images by Grzegorz Lityński and poems by Barbara Gruszka-Zych. The works form a luminous core exploring the silence and stories of Silesia and reflections on mortality.

name: Clem Burke - Rock ‘n’ Roll Memorial & Life Celebration
description: A special memorial and celebration of life for Clem Burke, featuring live music and tributes. Musicians and fans gather to honor a significant legacy in the rock world.
short_name: Clem Burke - Rock ‘n’ Roll Memorial & Life Celebration

name: Chinary Ung
description: Grawemeyer Award-winning composer Chinary Ung combines Cambodian folk traditions with contemporary classical techniques in this career-spanning Portrait. The Del Sol String Quartet performs several of his works, including a new world premiere commission.

name: Israel On Our Minds – Session Two
description: Ambassador Ido Aharoni continues his monthly update series on Israeli affairs, security, and global criticism. This session provides insider analysis of the rapidly shifting reality in the Middle East.
short_name: Israel On Our Minds – Session Two

name: Working Together in Theatre - With Joel Veenstra
description: Joel Veenstra shares insights on professional collaboration and the interpersonal dynamics of working in the theatrical industry.

name: Mae Martin: The Possum
description: Mae Martin performs their latest stand-up hour, "The Possum," blending comedy with personal observation.

name: Lecture Series - Glass in Context Part II: The Rise of the Designer
description: Jane Bruce examines the role of the designer in glass history from the 19th to the 21st century in this educational series session.

name: Shabaka
description: The celebrated saxophonist and composer Shabaka Hutchings presents his latest musical explorations. The performance spans jazz, African heritage, and contemporary experimental sounds.

name: STEM Night: Women in STEM
description: A virtual event for teens and young adults highlighting the career journeys and professional advice of women working across various STEM fields.

name: Melanin Madness Film Screening
description: In celebration of Women's History Month, The Apollo and Harlem-based film collective Melanin Madness host a special community film screening.

name: Percy Jones & Mj12
description: Seminal bassist Percy Jones leads MJ12 in a set combining prog-rock, free jazz, and sly humor.

name: CupcakKe
description: Rapper CupcakKe brings her high-energy, unapologetic, and provocative performance style to the Brooklyn stage. This concert is open to fans 16 and over.

name: Claude McKAY: From Harlem to Marseille
description: A screening and Q&A session focused on the life and work of Jamaican-American writer Claude McKay. The film traces his journey through the Harlem Renaissance and his wanderings in Europe.
short_name: Claude McKAY: From Harlem to Marseille

name: Spider Rabbit
description: An experimental production featuring surrealist puppetry and avant-garde performance elements.

name: Milo Rau & Édouard Louis: The Interrogation
location: NYU Skirball Center for the Performing Arts
description: A raw, intimate collaboration blending personal testimony with urgent political critique, revisiting moments of violence and class shame in France.

name: Rain Garden Stewardship Event
description: Join the NYC DEP Green Infrastructure team to learn gardening basics and how to become a steward for local rain gardens.

name: The Westerlies Play Bill Frisell: Album Release Show
description: This brass quartet premieres never-before-heard compositions from Bill Frisell's recent notebooks and highlights from his catalog.

name: Tony Trischka In Residence: Great Big World
description: Banjoist Tony Trischka performs a wide-ranging program exploring diverse musical landscapes and global influences.

name: Calla
description: A raw Butoh performance exploring the tension between fragility and resilience through slow, deliberate movement.

name: Eliane Elias - The Art of Bossa Nova
description: Multi-Grammy Award winner Eliane Elias brings the smooth sounds of Brazil to NYC with her special "Art of Bossa Nova" performance.
short_name: Eliane Elias - The Art of Bossa Nova

name: Teacher Workshop | Colors of the World
description: A professional development workshop for educators exploring global artistic traditions, pigment history, and cultural palettes.
short_name: Teacher Workshop | Colors of the World

name: Rob Osler: The Case of the Murdered Muckraker
description: Rob Osler visits the shop to discuss The Case of the Murdered Muckraker.
short_name: The Case of the Murdered Muckraker

name: Zara Larsson
description: Global pop star Zara Larsson brings her chart-topping hits and impressive choreography to the Brooklyn stage.

name: Unearthing the Earth: Architectural Histories of Extractivism
description: This HAUS-hosted symposium explores how to historicize extractivism's long durée from the perspective of architectural history.

name: oskar med k: Make Me Feel Tour 2026
description: Oskar med k brings his signature electronic and house-inspired sound to a late-night slot as part of his 2026 world tour. The event offers a modern club atmosphere with driving dance beats.
short_name: oskar med k: Make Me Feel Tour 2026

name: Gogol Bordello
description: The legendary gypsy punk band brings their chaotic and infectious energy for a high-octane live show. Expect a riotous blend of Eastern European folk, punk rock, and theatrical performance.

name: Enigma Variations & Bruch’s Violin Concerto
location: David Geffen Hall at Lincoln Center
description: Nikolaj Szeps-Znaider leads Bruch’s Violin Concerto No. 1 and Elgar’s legendary Enigma Variations.

name: Kyle Kinane
description: Kyle Kinane brings his gravelly voice and unique observations to the stage for a night of stand-up.

name: Ernest: Live from the South Tour
description: Country singer-songwriter ERNEST brings his "LIVE FROM THE SOUTH TOUR" to the Big Apple. Known for his storytelling, he delivers an authentic and heartfelt country music experience.
short_name: Ernest: Live from the South Tour

name: Robot Song
description: A dazzling theater work for kids and adults celebrating inclusion and creativity.

name: Boojum & Hot Like Mars
description: Loop Troupe presents "Electric Wonderland on Mars," a cosmic and funky live music experience.

name: Aaron Burnett and the Big Machine: Quantum Breaks II
description: New “Jazztronica” compositions inspired by electronic music techniques, UK drum ‘n’ bass, and hip-hop.

name: Steven Wendt: Plato Caves: Screens vs Shadows
description: Scientist Steven explores how shadows and sounds can match up to make feelings happen, loosely using Plato’s Allegory of the Cave. This performance is open to all ages, specifically designed for children 5 to 12 years old.

name: Bill Frisell: 75th Birthday Celebration
description: "In My Dreams" features Frisell with longtime collaborators Jenny Scheinman, Hank Roberts, and others in a sonic reunion.

name: Freak & Donna & Friends: The Finale!
description: This grand finale show features the premiere of the Freak & Donna series ender along with live talent performances.

name: Bach: St. John Passion
description: A deeply moving musical journey through Christ’s final hours, featuring intimate arias, urgent choruses, and beautiful chorales. This Lent concert offers a profound musical gateway into the heart of Holy Week.

name: Neuroscience WIP: Schoenblum & Williams
description: Final session of the current three-month block featuring internal neuroscience research updates.

name: Paper Decorations: Part 2/2
description: Continuation of the decorative paper series, focusing on advanced patterns and surface treatments.

name: Féile na Gaeilge / Irish Language Day 2026
description: A day-long celebration of the Irish language featuring story-focused workshops, conversation circles, and short films.
short_name: Féile na Gaeilge / Irish Language Day 2026

name: Gearrscannáin na Gaeilge / Irish Language Shorts
description: A screening of contemporary Irish language short films across various genres including comedy, drama, and history.
short_name: Gearrscannáin na Gaeilge / Irish Language Shorts

name: Seanchoíche
description: A storytelling night where volunteer speakers share personal narratives and poetry in the Irish language on the theme of "Home."

name: The Music of Taylor Swift: A Symphonic Tribute
description: A full orchestra performs symphonic arrangements of Taylor Swift's greatest hits from throughout her career.

name: Old 97's
description: Alt-country pioneers Old 97's return to the stage with support from artist Lizzie No. The band is celebrated for their energetic blend of power pop and traditional country roots.

name: Philharmonic Families: Winds
location: David Geffen Hall at Lincoln Center
description: An interactive and relaxed performance introducing families to the woodwind family of the orchestra.

name: Cock Sparrer
description: Legendary Oi! and punk rock band Cock Sparrer celebrate decades of anthemic songs for a two-night stand.

name: Mister Cobra
description: Lucy Liyou combines Korean folk opera and drag-inspired techniques in a solo performance confronting the boundaries of transition and personhood.

name: Uncle Vanya, scenes from country life

name: Kyle Kinane
description: Stand-up comedian Kyle Kinane brings his unique observations and storytelling to the stage for a night of laughs.

name: Street Tree Care with plant xchange
description: Join Big Reuse and plant xchange to improve local tree health and promote urban greening.

name: Nidia Góngora: Afro-Colombian Music

name: Israeli Chamber Project
description: An ensemble of award-winning Israeli musicians performs a program of classical and contemporary chamber works.

name: Bughouse - Closing Performance

name: Drain
description: California hardcore band Drain brings their high-intensity, surf-influenced thrash to the stage. Be prepared for a high-energy show and significant crowd participation.

name: Open Movement: Subject to Object: Self as Text
description: Jerron Harmon leads a workshop centering disability aesthetics to translate personal memory into shared movement and sound contexts.
short_name: Subject to Object: Self as Text

name: Meshell Ndegeocello
description: As part of NYC Winter Jazzfest, this performance features the restlessly collaborative and multi-disciplinary artistry of Meshell Ndegeocello.

name: Brooklyn Nets vs. Sacramento Kings
description: The Brooklyn Nets take on the Sacramento Kings in a Sunday matchup. Close out the weekend with world-class NBA action in Brooklyn.

name: Milo Rau & Servane Dècle: The Pelicot Trial
description: An urgent North American premiere featuring readings of examinations, pleas, and commentaries from the historic Mazan rape case trial. This production confronts the global system of patriarchy and violence against women.

name: WHCO Storytime with the Symphony: At Night
location: Recirculation, a project of Word Up
description: A bilingual family storytime and orchestral performance featuring "At Night" by local author Margaret Peot.

name: Joe Turner's Come and Gone

name: Joe Turner's Come and Gone
description: Taraji P. Henson makes her Broadway debut alongside Cedric the Entertainer in this revival of August Wilson’s classic play. Set in a 1911 Pittsburgh boardinghouse, the story follows residents navigating migration, identity, and the meaning of freedom.

name: BRIGHTCAST In-store Playday

name: Tana French celebrates THE KEEPER
description: Acclaimed mystery author Tana French celebrates her book The Keeper as part of the Midday Mystery virtual series. This event features a live discussion with the author.

description: The LA-based trio Moonchild brings their smooth blend of alternative R&B and jazz to NYC. Their lush arrangements and soulful harmonies create a beautiful and relaxed live atmosphere.

description: The environmental fable "Woman at War" follows an Icelandic activist waging a solo war on the local aluminum industry.

name: rusowsky
description: Spanish artist rusowsky brings his unique blend of bedroom pop and electronic music to Brooklyn. His sound often incorporates jazz and R&B elements into a modern indie framework.

name: Season Finale: Jeffrey Siegel
